description: This file implements the affine grid generator functions for 4D and 5D tensors, including forward and backward operations, for use in spatial transformer networks within the PyTorch framework.

methods.name: at::Tensor linspace_from_neg_one(const Tensor & grid,int64_t num_steps,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Generates a linear space from -1 to 1 with optional alignment adjustment.

methods.name: Tensor make_base_grid_4D(const Tensor & theta,int64_t N,int64_t C,int64_t H,int64_t W,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Creates a 4D base grid tensor for affine transformation.

methods.name: Tensor make_base_grid_5D(const Tensor & theta,int64_t N,int64_t C,int64_t D,int64_t H,int64_t W,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Creates a 5D base grid tensor for volumetric affine transformation.

methods.name: Tensor affine_grid_generator_4D(const Tensor & theta,int64_t N,int64_t C,int64_t H,int64_t W,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Generates a 4D affine grid for spatial transformer given theta.

methods.name: Tensor affine_grid_generator_5D(const Tensor & theta,int64_t N,int64_t C,int64_t D,int64_t H,int64_t W,bool align_corners)

methods.name: Tensor affine_grid_generator(const Tensor & theta,IntArrayRef size,bool align_corners)
methods.description: Dispatches call to generate 4D or 5D affine grid based on input size.
